title: Lagged Bitcoin one-year active-supply contraction DRA V1 entry admission
thesis: A declining fraction of Bitcoin supply active during the trailing year may identify holder absorption and lower dormant-supply distribution pressure behind otherwise valid DRA momentum entries. Restricting new entries to this contraction state may improve equal-capital path risk without changing exits or existing lots.
mechanism: For each complete Sunday D, compare the mean reviewed daily BTC SplyActPct1yr over D minus 27 through D with the mean over D minus 55 through D minus 28. Beginning at D plus three calendar days 00:00 UTC and for at most 168 hours, admit an otherwise unchanged DRA V1 parent signal only when the current mean is strictly lower; otherwise veto the new entry.
economic_rationale: The feature is useful only if it improves Design and Validation total and realized PnL while preserving unrealized PnL, drawdown, underwater duration, holding and terminal inventory, intervenes often enough, and has annual and predictive breadth. Fewer trades, a single cycle, price endogeneity or terminal-inventory cleanup is insufficient.
